abstract.p: User 1 User 2 Warm User 3 Warm User 4 Item 1 Item 2 Item 3 UltraGCN-Frozen weights / old users-Changable weights / warm users Folding-In Approach Figure 1: The image illustrates the warm-start scenarios, with warm users-those who have new interactions-marked in red, and others in blue. The scheme on the right presents the Folding-In approach for the UltraGCN [20] graph-based recommender system. The user embedding matrix is denoted as 𝑈 , and the item embedding matrix as 𝑉. In the solution, 𝑎 𝑢 is the vector of user 𝑢 interactions, the element 𝛽 𝑢 and the diagonal matrix 𝐵 𝐼 contain information about the graph structure and 𝑉 + denotes a pseudo-inversed matrix. Trainable user embeddings (𝑒 𝑢) are shown in red, while frozen embeddings are shown in blue.
